en.p: For a positive number $c$, there is a hyperbola with foci $\mathrm{F}(c,\,0)$, $\mathrm{F'}(-c,\,0)$ and transverse axis of length $6$. Find the sum of all values of $c$ for which there exist two distinct points $\mathrm{P}$, $\mathrm{Q}$ on this hyperbola satisfying the following conditions. [4 points]

box: (A) Point $\mathrm{P}$ lies in the first quadrant, and point $\mathrm{Q}$ lies on line $\mathrm{PF'}$.
